newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline holds steady ahead of Euro stock data.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline holds steady ahead of Euro stock data.

text.p: NWE gasoline prices held steady on Tuesday despite a rebound in crude oil futures as traders awaited monthly European oil inventory data due out at 1300 gmt.
A closed arbitrage to the States and views that inventories were more than adequate were hanging over the barge market and keeping a lid on prices, traders said.
Eurograde barges were quoted roughly unchanged at $188/$190 fob ARA. Deals were done at $185 and $188 fob ARA and at $189 for refinery material, they said.
"It's going down," said one barge trader. "There is enough product around so buyers aren't worried...and there has been only one buyer."
Analysts expected a sizeable increase in crude oil inventories for May as reported by Euroilstock, though the build was seen short of the 13 million barrel rise in April.

Expectations for products were cloudier but gasoline was seen as the only component to have fallen. Exports out of the region will only slightly offset weaker demand, leading to a small drawdown, they said.
